task.title: Find the mistakes in a vendor invoice and write to the vendor
task.brief: You check vendor bills before payment. Compare the invoice below with the purchase order and the goods receipt. List every mistake you find and the correct figures. Then write a short, polite email to the vendor asking for a corrected invoice. Take about 20 minutes. A good answer finds all the mistakes, shows the right amounts, and explains clearly what the vendor must change. It also says the payment is on hold until the corrected invoice comes.
task.material:
PURCHASE ORDER PO-7731 (Kaveri Logistics Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad, Telangana, GSTIN 36AAACK1234L1Z2)
Item: Office chair, 50 units @ Rs 2,400 = Rs 1,20,000 + GST 18%

GOODS RECEIPT GRN-2290: Office chair, 50 units received in good condition.

VENDOR INVOICE
Bright Seat Furniture, Hyderabad, Telangana, GSTIN 36AAFCB5678M1Z9
Invoice No: BSF/26/0412   Invoice date: (blank)
Bill to: Kaveri Logistics Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad, Telangana
PO ref: PO-7731
Office chair  55 units x Rs 2,400 = Rs 1,32,000
IGST @ 18% = Rs 23,760
Total = Rs 1,55,670
key_points: Quantity billed is 55, but PO and goods receipt show 50
Both parties are in Telangana, so CGST 9% + SGST 9% should be charged, not IGST
Total is added wrongly: 1,32,000 + 23,760 is 1,55,760, not 1,55,670
Correct invoice: taxable Rs 1,20,000, CGST Rs 10,800, SGST Rs 10,800, total Rs 1,41,600
Email asks for a corrected invoice and says payment is on hold until then
Polite, clear email that quotes the PO and invoice numbers

rubric.label: Mistakes found
rubric.guide: 0 = one or none found; 3 = two or three found; 5 = all four found with correct figures

rubric.label: Correct amounts
rubric.guide: 0 = wrong totals; 3 = small slip in tax or total; 5 = taxable value, CGST, SGST and total all right

rubric.label: Clear email
rubric.guide: 0 = vague or confusing; 3 = clear but missing references; 5 = short, quotes PO and invoice, lists each change

rubric.label: Tone
rubric.guide: 0 = rude or blaming; 3 = polite but stiff; 5 = polite, firm and professional
